extension.description: Copy the selected lines as an @file:line reference, optionally with the code, ready to paste into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other AI agents.
command.copy.title: Copy for Agent
config.template.description:
Template used by **Copy for Agent** in the editor context menu. The **Copy for Agent with Template** submenu copies with any other template once, without changing this setting.

No keyboard shortcuts are bound by default. [Set keyboard shortcuts](command:workbench.action.openGlobalKeybindings?%5B%22copy4agent.%22%5D) for **Copy for Agent** or for any single template.
config.template.atPath.label: @ reference
config.template.atPathWithCode.label: @ reference + code
config.template.atPathHashL.label: @ reference, #L style
config.template.plainPath.label: Plain path
config.template.atPath.description:
`@src/app.py:10-30`

Path and line numbers only; the agent reads the lines from disk itself. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and most agents that understand `@` file mentions. Recommended.
config.template.atPathWithCode.descripti:
`@src/app.py:10-30` followed by the selected code as-is on the next lines.

For terminal agents (Claude Code, Codex, DSH…) when you want the exact snippet in the conversation.
config.template.atPathWithFencedCode.des:
`@src/app.py:10-30` followed by the selected code in a Markdown fenced block with a language tag.

For chat UIs that render Markdown (Cursor chat, web chats).
config.template.atPathHashL.description:
`@src/app.py#L10-30`

The format Claude Code's own IDE integration inserts for file references.
config.template.plainPath.description:
`src/app.py:10-30`

No `@` prefix. For agents or input boxes where `@` opens a file picker or isn't understood. Also Cmd/Ctrl-clickable in the VS Code terminal.
submenu.copyWithTemplate.label: Copy for Agent with Template
Show the **Copy for Agent with Template** submenu in the editor context menu.
